text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: spike in 500s for /v1/embeddings (region: eu-west-1). 98% of errors show fallback to model 'redwood-chat-small-v2' which is a chat variant. Suspected cause: pinned version mismatch leading to variant-incompatible fallback. Auto-detect triggered at 12:07:01 UTC
oncall-bot: @sarah you're oncall for infra this rotation — paging now :pager:
sarah: on it. pulling logs and router traces. can someone drop recent routing policy for the customer route?
arjun: grabbing smart-router logs. quick summary: a commit to alias-mappings yesterday replaced anchor 'ds-embed' -> 'redwood-embed-v1' but the alias->variant map is pointing at 'redwood-chat-small-v2' (instruct/chat). looks like an alias swap + wrong variant mapping.
sarah: ugh. customer traffic that should hit embeddings got routed to chat model, so embed endpoint tries to call gen runtime -> schema mismatch -> 500s. can we confirm which config changed?
arjun: yes, here's the snippet from the live config at 12:02: (copied from control plane)
```
{"route":"/v1/embeddings","alias":"ds-embed","pinned_version":"redwood-embed-v1","variant_mapping":{
  "ds-embed":"redwood-chat-small-v2"
}}
```
this mapping is wrong — variant_mapping should point to an embedding-compatible variant or to a family fallback, not a chat variant.
sarah: thanks. i'm going to patch the mapping to use the correct embed variant and then clear the pin if it was incorrectly anchored. executing rollback now.
sarah: runbook step: revert alias mapping -> set variant_mapping ds-embed -> redwood-embed-v1-quant
```
# control-plane cli
redwoodctl alias set-variant ds-embed redwood-embed-v1-quant --reason "emergency rollback: wrong chat variant mapped"
```
sarah: running the command...
arjun: while that's running, i'm throttling upstream to reduce failed calls and setting a temporary route-level policy to prefer family fallback instead of strict variant fallback.
arjun: applying temporary routing override:
```
PATCH /config/routes/ds-embed
{
  "fallback_policy": "family-prefer",
  "max_inflight": 60
}
```
mike: support update — Customer DataStream reports ~42 failed embedding requests since 12:05, their ingestion job retried and queued. They see 500s and webhook timeouts; I've opened ticket DS-8312 and informed CS. ct: medium-high impact.
sarah: rollback applied, routing override in place. seeing error rate drop from 95%->8% over last 30s. continuing to monitor.
arjun: confirming: routing table now shows ds-embed -> redwood-embed-v1-quant. live traces show calls hitting embed runtime, kernel selection OK. no downstream runtime OOMs.
support-bot: DS-8312 created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/DS-8312 — assigned to mike.
mike: posting a brief customer-facing note: "We've identified and mitigated the issue; embeddings are restored and we're investigating the root cause and will follow up with a postmortem. Apologies for the disruption." sending now.
lee: i'm taking the handoff in 15m for post-incident follow-up. @sarah @arjun please add timeline + config commit id to DS-8312 and flag if change was manual or automated.
sarah: adding timeline and the emergency cli commands run + control-plane audit id: audit_987654. change looked like an automated alias migration from 2026-11-02 but the variant map in that migration referenced a deprecated chat alias. submitting PR to add validation to alias-migrations to block variant-family mismatches.
arjun: i'll make a hotfix patch for the control plane: validate alias->variant family compatibility, and add a panic check that blocks applying alias mapping if route type != variant type. estimate 2h.
lee: good. next steps: 1) support to finish customer comms 2) arjun to ship validation hotfix 3) postmortem in incident channel + sev level review tomorrow 09:00 UTC 4) check other aliases deployed in same window for similar drift.
sarah: handing off active monitoring to @lee. i'll stay available if it reoccurs. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> reduced error rate, customer impact contained. follow-up tasks created: DS-8312 (support), INC-2026-987 (engineering postmortem).
metadata: mitigation: rollback alias mapping; temp routing override; throttled upstream; ticket DS-8312; audit id audit_987654
